name: smart-agents
description: Four model-pinned delegation agents — scout (Haiku recon), researcher (Sonnet web briefs), worker (Sonnet code changes), deep-thinker (Opus reasoning). Cuts costs by routing to the cheapest model that can do the job. SessionStart hook injects delegation discipline every session; deep-thinker dispatch asks for confirmation first since it's the most expensive tier. Pairs with cheap-explore, which pins the built-in Explore agent this plugin cannot replace.
